name: Price or specification not in line with commercial norms
description: Equipment priced far above or below market, or specifications altered to fall below control thresholds.
fp: Prices vary with customisation and volume.

sources.text: FATF, Guidance on Counter Proliferation Financing (2018)
FATF, Guidance on Proliferation Financing Risk Assessment and Mitigation (2021)
